name: A package cannot self-authorize trusted reflection

applicability.reason: Supported. C009 makes trusted reflection policy exist ONLY through Host configuration and forbids a package from self-authorizing, and the host `iris.grants` boundary that supplies it already exists beside the manifest, which is what this row was held on. A package requesting `reflection.inspect` and `reflection.mutate` in its OWN manifest is denied both, which C102 makes the two independent halves of the policy. Verified against fixtures/meta/v910-host-granted that the identical manifest succeeds once the HOST grants them, so the denial comes from the missing grant rather than from the operations being unavailable. A structural change such as set_superclass is deliberately not covered here: C102 scopes ReflectionPolicy to list/get and set/remove, and MetaCapabilities owns the structural path.
